391: /// Create a bounded, multi-producer, multi-consumer channel where each sent
392: /// value is broadcasted to all active receivers.
393: ///
394: /// All data sent on [`Sender`] will become available on every active
395: /// [`Receiver`] in the same order as it was sent.
396: ///
397: /// The `Sender` can be cloned to `send` to the same channel from multiple
398: /// points in the process or it can be used concurrently from an `Arc`. New
399: /// `Receiver` handles are created by calling [`Sender::subscribe`].
400: ///
401: /// If all [`Receiver`] handles are dropped, the `send` method will return a
402: /// [`SendError`]. Similarly, if all [`Sender`] handles are dropped, the [`recv`]
403: /// method will return a [`RecvError`].
404: ///
405: /// [`Sender`]: crate::sync::broadcast::Sender
406: /// [`Sender::subscribe`]: crate::sync::broadcast::Sender::subscribe
407: /// [`Receiver`]: crate::sync::broadcast::Receiver
408: /// [`recv`]: crate::sync::broadcast::Receiver::recv
409: /// [`SendError`]: crate::sync::broadcast::error::SendError
410: /// [`RecvError`]: crate::sync::broadcast::error::RecvError
411: ///
412: /// # Examples
413: ///
414: /// ```
415: /// use tokio::sync::broadcast;
416: ///
417: /// #[tokio::main]
418: /// async fn main() {
419: ///     let (tx, mut rx1) = broadcast::channel(16);
420: ///     let mut rx2 = tx.subscribe();
421: ///
422: ///     tokio::spawn(async move {
423: ///         assert_eq!(rx1.recv().await.unwrap(), 10);
424: ///         assert_eq!(rx1.recv().await.unwrap(), 20);
425: ///     });
426: ///
427: ///     tokio::spawn(async move {
428: ///         assert_eq!(rx2.recv().await.unwrap(), 10);
429: ///         assert_eq!(rx2.recv().await.unwrap(), 20);
430: ///     });
431: ///
432: ///     tx.send(10).unwrap();
433: ///     tx.send(20).unwrap();
434: /// }
435: /// ```
436: ///
437: /// # Panics
438: ///
439: /// This will panic if `capacity` is equal to `0` or larger
440: /// than `usize::MAX / 2`.
441: #[track_caller]

part.text:
Fixed the broadcast closed-resubscription behavior in `tokio/src/sync/broadcast.rs`.

A receiver created via `resubscribe()` or `Sender::subscribe()` after channel closure now starts at the close sentinel rather than just beyond it. Consequently, both `recv()` and `try_recv()` return `Closed` instead of hanging or returning `Empty`.
